title: Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Courtesy Schedule: Account Tenure Share
content:
**Schedule.** On a Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards account, the courtesy credit on a late fee is the late fee being reversed times the courtesy share, rounded half up to the cent, and the tenure share is a term of that courtesy share: the tenure share is 0.6 for an account open at least 120 full calendar months since its opened date, 0.5 for one open at least 60 but fewer than 120 full calendar months, and 0.4 for any other account. The courtesy share is never below zero and never above 1.0.

The opened date is read from the account record; the months run from it to today.

| Full calendar months since the opened date | Tenure share |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 0.6 |
| 60 to 119 | 0.5 |
| fewer than 60 | 0.4 |

## Boundaries (hypothetical accounts)

| Account open | Tenure share |
|---|---|
| 59 full months | 0.4 |
| 60 full months | 0.5 |
| 119 full months | 0.5 |
| 120 full months | 0.6 |
| opened 14 years ago | 0.6 |
